ledger: handheld tool | white stick (foreground), blue razor (reflection) | white stick (foreground), blue razor (reflection) | reflection morphs to comb then back to razor

findings.description: The object held by the man in the foreground is a white stick, but its reflection in the mirror appears as a blue razor.
The blue razor in the mirror reflection morphs into a black comb as the man brings it to his hair, and then morphs back into a razor when he returns it to his face.
